Root and privileged system administrator are fully trusted; signer key and durable frontier cannot resist privileged root or whole-root-filesystem rollback.
Only a fixed synthetic Python script is launched, not real Claude or Codex. No general shell/network sandbox for arbitrary worker code.
Root initializer executes owner-approved untrusted unittest code as the unprivileged worker UID; it is not network sandboxed and must be used on disposable approved repos only.
Concurrent changes are rejected before spawn and worker consumes immutable staging snapshot. No mid-execution revocation or zombie-agent termination.
Signed receipts prove owner-controller testimony, not independent observation that every consequence occurred or code is correct.
Conventional comparator shares implementation and has expected parity; separate operator experience, integration effort and adoption not established.
